## Publication Information

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (January 1855-February 1861)

**Notes:** 'Cathedral Sketches' was a series of 15 articles on English cathedrals which ran in <i>MP</i> between January 1855 and February 1861.  'E.P. R.' (<i.>i.e.</i> Elizabeth P. Roberts), CMY herself, and 'A. M. G.'(<i>i.e.</i> A. M. Goodrich) were among the contributors.
